WITH route3 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-121.580616 45.698687, -121.580788 45.698419, -121.581072 45.698374, -121.583005 45.698452, -121.583335 45.698426, -121.583511 45.698348, -121.584036 45.697562, -121.584229 45.697442, -121.584615 45.69733, -121.585098 45.697304, -121.58528 45.697356, -121.585468 45.697528)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
route4 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-85.659984 42.198758, -85.659915 42.198655, -85.659784 42.198603, -85.659166 42.198577, -85.658801 42.198642, -85.65855 42.198738, -85.658284 42.198954, -85.658142 42.199224)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip3 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route3 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
dem_clip4 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route4 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT 1 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route3 r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route4 r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    ST_StartPoint(seg)         AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)           AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography)  AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.route_id,
    e.seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p1)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p1) END AS z1,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p2)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p2) END AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip3 dc3, dem_clip4 dc4
),
grades AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM grades
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY route_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN a1.g >= a2.g THEN 'Westwood Drive' ELSE 'South Red Pine Circle' END AS answer_name,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a1.g)) AS slope_deg_3,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a2.g)) AS slope_deg_4
FROM avg_grade a1
JOIN avg_grade a2
  ON a1.route_id = 1 AND a2.route_id = 2
WHERE a1.g IS NOT NULL AND a2.g IS NOT NULL;

  SELECT 'South Red Pine Circle'::text AS name, ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-85.659984 42.198758, -85.659915 42.198655, -85.659784 42.198603, -85.659166 42.198577, -85.658801 42.198642, -85.65855 42.198738, -85.658284 42.198954, -85.658142 42.199224)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
westwood_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    'Westwood Drive'::text AS name,
    ST_Avg(ST_Slope(r.rast, 1, '32BF')) AS avg_slope
  FROM 
    westwood_drive w,
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast::geometry, w.geom)
    AND ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, w.geom, TRUE) IS NOT NULL
),
south_red_pine_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    'South Red Pine Circle'::text AS name,
    ST_Avg(ST_Slope(r.rast, 1, '32BF')) AS avg_slope
  FROM 
    south_red_pine_circle s,
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast::geometry, s.geom)
    AND ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, s.geom, TRUE) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN w.avg_slope > s.avg_slope THEN w.name
    WHEN s.avg_slope > w.avg_slope THEN s.name
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS higher_slope,
  w.avg_slope AS westwood_avg_slope,
  s.avg_slope AS south_red_pine_avg_slope
FROM 
  westwood_slope w,
  south_red_pine_slope s;
